newsitem.title: INDIA: India says direct tax revenue up 14.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: India says direct tax revenue up 14.7 pct.

text.p: India's Finance Ministry said on Tuesday its direct tax revenue in the first 11 months of 1996/97 (April-March) rose 14.7 percent over the same period last year.

Total revenue from corporate, income and interest taxes was 278.72 billion until the end of February in 1996/97, compared with 242.89 billion in the corresponding period of the previous year, the ministry said in its annual report for 1996/97.

The government had collected 129.40 billion rupees from corporate taxes up to February, compared to 121.58 billion in the same period in the previous year, it said. Income tax revenue amounted to 138.24 billion rupees compared with 116.66 billion in the same period last year.
The government collected 11.08 billion rupees from interest tax against 4.65 billion in the same period in the previous year, it said. ($1 = 35.8 rupees)
